title: Design System: Cohamy public storefront and shared footer

footer-detail.purpose: Every public-footer text element retains one Manrope size across viewports.

footer-heading.purpose: Weight distinguishes headings and the legal company name without changing family or size.

display.purpose: Compact two-line hero with locale and breakpoint overrides.

title.purpose: Playfair names below the eight complete product frames.

body.purpose: 16px public root scoped by data-public-storefront; internal roots remain unchanged.

metadata.purpose: Opaque warm-brown date/location text; small sizes still require contrast.

commerce-action.purpose: Existing Barlow Condensed purchase action; homepage compact size is 18px.

commerce-title.purpose: Existing non-home Barlow Condensed catalog card title.

narrative.overview: "Cacao Scenes" keeps the original Cohamy product and exhibition photographs, warm paper, cacao fields and gold actions. Playfair Display supplies the heading character; Manrope carries navigation, supporting copy and facts. The user-authorized refinement makes public typography smaller and displays complete photographs instead of the previous cover crops.
keyCharacteristics: Original product photographs and the original transparent gold wordmark.
Cacao and paper surfaces with compact gold actions.
Playfair Display headings with Manrope controls and supporting text; the existing Barlow Condensed commerce face retains its limited purchase/catalog role.
Eight open product articles in a four-column desktop grid, with prices and commerce controls supplied by the existing components.
Whole photographic frames in balanced content rows, fine rules, underlined links and a compact mobile shell.

rules.name: Public Boundary
rules.body: Apply the public 16px root and scoped type variables only when `[data-public-storefront]` is present. Apply the homepage scene/header system only to the locale-aware homepage. The documented shared footer applies across public routes. Keep internal CRM/portal typography outside this boundary.

rules.name: Original Asset
rules.body: Keep original photograph and wordmark pixels. Show complete promotional, About and gallery frames at their actual aspect ratios; product photo slots use `object-fit: contain`. Do not redraw packaging or the supplied brand mark.

rules.name: Paper and Cacao
rules.body: Use paper with ink for open homepage content and cacao with paper for the shell and action scenes. Gold identifies actions and the supplied wordmark.

rules.name: Two Voice
rules.body: Preserve Playfair Display for homepage headings and Manrope for supporting copy and controls. Retain Barlow Condensed only in its existing commerce roles. The historical tool-ranked Rasa face is not the implementation.

rules.name: Shared Footer Type
rules.body: Keep every footer heading, link, fact and copyright line at the `footer-detail` size and family on every viewport. Use the `footer-heading` weight for headings and the legal name, and weight (600) for contact labels; no mobile size reduction applies.

rules.name: Flat Content
rules.body: Keep product articles and article rows flat. The photograph, surface contrast and fine rules provide depth; the existing locale popover retains its incumbent treatment.

rules.name: Small Corner
rules.body: Use the action radius for gold actions. Preserve the whole-frame photography and existing locale control; do not reshape the control into a product card.

dos: Do apply the Public Boundary Rule before changing public type or using homepage scene styles.
Do keep original asset pixels, logo transparency, complete promotional frames and existing product/link targets.
Do show the complete eight-product range in the documented responsive grid.
Do retain the observed small-screen hierarchy, locale overrides, 44px controls and visible keyboard focus.
Do source prices, article titles and order-intake state from their existing runtime authorities.
Do preserve the shared footer's four groups, uniform 16px type and factual content.
donts: Don't propagate the homepage scene/header world or public root scale into CRM/portal workspaces.
Don't use the historical tool-ranked Rasa face as an implementation rule.
Don't reconstruct the original wordmark or packaging, or crop a whole-frame photograph merely to fill a shallow banner.
Don't invent prices, reviews, certification claims, stock facts or delivery evidence.
Don't turn historical refused comp gates, current defects or detector findings outside this public scope into reusable design rules.
